id: D57 stage 0: does a head-only network that reads the whole shot beat the same network restricted to the frame?
author: first_agent; entrant 2026-10-13: 'navrhni sieť čítajúcu celý výboj naraz' then 'spusti'
why: Every tested route on the frame-wise heads ended at zero (ledger 2.63-2.71). Two things only a whole-shot reader could use: the internal inductance follows current diffusion over hundreds of milliseconds to seconds, and a per-shot offset holds 21-39 % of each head's error (D13) and is not shared with similar shots (D53). Earlier temporal tests were negative (D5: lags to +-8 frames in a boosted corrector; D20: raw +-10 ms windows), but none read the whole shot.
model: temporal_model.py: per-frame trunk 582 -> 4 x 512 (SiLU); projection to 128 plus sinusoidal code of seconds since the discharge began (feature column 64, 8 periods 0.04-25 s); 2 pre-norm blocks of 4-head self-attention over the frames of one shot and a 128-256-128 perceptron, output projections zero at the start; heads read trunk activation and mixed vector; 9 outputs

arms.temporal: attention over all frames of the crop
arms.control: identical parameters, layers and arithmetic; every frame attends only to itself

targets: r_axis, z_axis, q95, beta_n from the table labels; kappa, tri_top, tri_bot, volume, li_scored from the true-map teacher targets (as D47); per-target normalised, masked squared error weighted 5.5, 5.5, 4.9, 0.55, 0.55, 2.1, 10.6, 2.4, 6.8 (microS per percent of rms error; mean-normalised)
training: the 6326 shots outside both evaluation cohorts (D38 eligible rows; 1 404 214 frames); crops of 256 consecutive frames (whole shot when shorter, padded and masked), 8 shots per step chosen in proportion to length, 60 epochs x 685 steps, one-cycle Adam at .002, weight decay 1e-5, gradient limit 1; both arms take the same crops for the same seed; seeds 800-807 (8 per arm); local ROCm cards
quality_rule: final-10 mean training loss <= 1.25 x lowest contiguous 10-mean and finite, per member; all 8 of an arm or none; no refit, no seed replaced
measure: head_report.py on all 358 development shots (120 exposed many times, 238 used by D43, D51, D52 and the second agent's readout study): each arm's 8-member mean, whole shot in one pass, blended .5 with the deployed heads; predicted score change of the blend P = 11.0 pct(axis) + 10.6 pct(li) + 4.9 pct(kappa) + 2.1 pct(volume) + 1.1 pct(tri) + 75000 x (dR2 q95 + dR2 betaN) microS; paired bootstrap over whole shots, 10000 resamples, seed 5701
rule: PASS if P(temporal) - P(control) >= 30 microS with a positive share of resamples >= .95 and P(temporal) > 0 (the temporal blend must also be better than the deployed heads). PASS -> stage 1 is written and frozen (all-data refits, nested blend weight, finisher, the 357, public submission, package). FAIL -> whole-shot context adds nothing to these heads in this form; closed, no second architecture is tried on this cohort.
exposure: Mechanics only before the freeze: seed 9001, 40 and 400 optimisation steps of each arm; mean training losses printed (7.06/6.88 at 40 steps, 3.29/2.96 at 400). No evaluation shot was read. No architecture or setting was changed after those numbers.
cost: about half an hour per fit on one card; two processes (one per arm) because of host memory
